core: Pathogen interaction with host epithelial cells
qualifier: exploitation of cell junctions and actin cytoskeleton
name: Pathogen exploitation of epithelial junctions and actin cytoskeleton
rationale: Members cover bacterial attachment and entry (Listeria InlA), actin-driven motility, SARS-CoV targeting of junctional PDZ proteins and host signalling, and LRRFIP1 sensing; unlike the toxin, Mtb-phagosome and viral-maturation confusables, the focus is junction/cytoskeleton subversion at the epithelial surface.

name: Mitotic centrosome maturation
rationale: All members describe recruitment or loss of proteins (NuMA, Nlp, TPX2-AURKA) at mitotic centrosomes, distinct from confusables on centrosome positioning, microtubule nucleation and spindle orientation.

name: Methylmalonyl-CoA mutase defects in propionyl-CoA catabolism
rationale: Members are propionyl-CoA catabolism and MUT, MMAA and MMAB defects causing methylmalonic acidemia, separating it from cobalamin metabolism/transport and branched-chain amino acid catabolism confusables.

qualifier: de novo synthesis, deoxynucleotide and pyrimidine metabolism
name: De novo nucleotide synthesis, deoxynucleotide and pyrimidine metabolism
rationale: Members span de novo purine and pyrimidine synthesis, NDP/NTP interconversion, deoxyribonucleotide synthesis and catabolism and pyrimidine salvage/catabolism, whereas confusables centre on purine salvage, nucleotide drug ADME, NUDT hydrolysis and nucleoside transport.

name: FGF receptor signaling via FRS2/SHC-MAPK and its regulation
rationale: All members are FGFR signaling, with FRS- and SHC-mediated MAPK cascades plus Sprouty, FGFRL1 and positive/negative regulation, distinguishing it from FGFR confusables dominated by PLC-gamma and PI3K arms and from generic RAS-MAPK feedback.

qualifier: essential transition metals (zinc, copper, manganese, iron)
name: Cellular response to essential transition metal ions
rationale: Members are responses to zinc, copper, manganese and iron, metallothionein binding and MTF1 induction, distinguishing it from confusables on cadmium/mercury detoxification, metal transporters and ROS.

qualifier: metabolic response to activity and disuse
name: Skeletal muscle metabolic adaptation to activity and disuse
rationale: Members cover muscle activity/inactivity responses, atrophy, fast-slow fiber transition, PGC-1alpha activation, glucocorticoid response and nucleotide/fermentative metabolism, unlike confusables on muscle growth, regeneration and cardiac hypertrophy.

name: AP-1 immediate-early transcriptional response
rationale: Members are AP-1 activation and network, immediate-early growth-factor-induced and TNF-NFkB-induced gene programs, distinct from UV/p38, JNK kinase activation and ARE-mediated mRNA decay confusables.

name: Selenium metabolism, selenoprotein synthesis and thyroid hormone action
rationale: Members combine ingested selenium metabolism, selenocysteine synthesis and readthrough with thyroid hormone generation, transport and receptor signaling, unlike confusables on iodide/sulfate transport and hydrogen peroxide metabolism.

name: Sex steroid biosynthesis and androgen metabolism
rationale: Members cover pregnenolone, progesterone, androgen and estrogen synthesis, aromatase deficiency and androgen catabolism, while confusables are glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid synthesis and their enzyme defects.

name: Vitamin C-centred antioxidant defence and redox homeostasis
rationale: Members are ascorbate metabolism, transport and response, vitamin E and selenium responses, ROS detoxification and redox homeostasis, distinct from iron, BH4/NOS, thyroid-H2O2 and aldehyde/NADPH confusables.

qualifier: Hox gene clusters, hindbrain and neural plate
name: Hox gene clusters in hindbrain and neural plate patterning
rationale: Members are Hox clusters plus anterior HOX activation in hindbrain, neural plate and border specification, rhombomere and boundary formation, and dorsoventral axis, whereas confusables lack the Hox clusters and centre on craniofacial organs, somitogenesis or axial mesoderm.

name: ESCRT-mediated multivesicular body sorting and receptor downregulation
rationale: Members cover ESCRT and MVB biogenesis, ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis and EGFR downregulation, exosome assembly and non-lytic viral release, unlike autophagy confusables and ESCRT-III budding/abscission confusables.

name: Lipoprotein receptor endocytosis, degradation and LDL clearance
rationale: Members concern LDL/VLDL receptor internalisation, lysosomal degradation, reduced recycling and LDL clearance with sterol homeostasis, unlike triglyceride-rich lipoprotein remodeling and SREBP/cholesterol-synthesis confusables.

qualifier: ribosome quality control and stress granules
name: Proteasomal degradation, ribosome quality control and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members are proteasome function and its regulation, degron pathways, ribosome-associated quality control and stress granule assembly/disassembly, whereas confusables emphasise ubiquitin chain types, ERAD/aggrephagy or PKR stress signaling.

name: Response to gasotransmitters, peroxide and ischemia
rationale: Members are responses to nitric oxide, reactive nitrogen, hydrogen sulfide, hydrogen peroxide, ischemia and oxygen metabolism, distinct from ROS-detoxification, ferroptosis and peroxide-induced death confusables.

name: Lymphocyte homing and chemotaxis into lymphoid organs
rationale: Members cover lymphocyte homing and migration into lymphoid organs, B, T and dendritic cell chemotaxis and marginal zone B cell differentiation, separating it from generic chemokine signaling and S1P/lymph node development confusables.

name: Stress granule dynamics and aggresome clearance by aggrephagy
rationale: Members are stress granule assembly, protein localisation and disassembly plus aggresome assembly and aggrephagy, unlike ribosome quality control and ERAD/misfolded-protein confusables.

name: Positive regulation of p53-dependent apoptotic transcription
rationale: Members are TP53 transcription of death receptor, caspase and cytochrome c release genes plus positive regulation of p53 expression and activity, distinguishing it from confusables on negative regulation, PUMA and p21-mediated G1 arrest.

name: Mitochondrial protein import and outer membrane organization
rationale: Members are mitochondrial protein import, matrix import, membrane localisation and outer membrane organization, unlike confusables on mitochondrial protein processing/degradation, OXPHOS assembly or cristae.

core: Essential metal ion transport and homeostasis
name: Zinc, copper and manganese transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members cover SLC39/SLC30 zinc transport, copper import and detoxification, ceruloplasmin and manganese transport, distinct from cadmium, iron-export and metallothionein confusables.

name: Carnitine-dependent fatty acid uptake for beta-oxidation
rationale: Members are the carnitine shuttle, carnitine transport and its deficiency and promotion of fatty acid oxidation, unlike malonyl-CoA control, ketone body and monocarboxylate transport confusables.

name: Tooth and hair follicle ectodermal appendage development
rationale: Members cover odontogenesis, odontoblasts and cementum together with hair follicle placode formation and ectodermal differentiation, distinct from skin/epidermis, dentinogenesis/eruption and EDA-NF-kB confusables.

name: Craniofacial and inner, middle, outer ear morphogenesis
rationale: Members are face, neurocranium and viscerocranium morphogenesis with otic vesicle, cochlea, semicircular canal, middle and outer ear and vestibulocochlear nerve formation, whereas confusables add glands, palate, cranial ganglia or olfactory development.

name: Negative regulation of type I interferon and cGAS-STING signaling
rationale: Members are negative regulation of IFN-beta production, type I IFN signaling and cGAS/STING with TREX1 and IFNA/IFNB regulation, distinct from confusables on IRF3-mediated induction and RIG-I/MDA5 positive signaling.
